page.overview:
What is 8th Branch?

8th Branch belongs to One Piece. The Marine 8th Branch is a non-canon Marine unit active in East Blue, commanded by Nelson Royal.

The division consists of Nelson's flagship and a fleet of at least ten smaller battleships. They also hired Eric the Whirlwind to bolster their military forces, but was betrayed by the mercenary when he found them no use to his personal agenda any longer. The unit possesses a small fleet of at least 10 ships along with the special flag ship.
